explanations.title: Deduplicate, rank, and cap findings
explanations.summary: Findings for the same file and overlapping lines are consolidated when their titles are sufficiently similar, keeping the strongest one. The results are ordered by severity and confidence, then capped at 15 by default (or the requested positive limit), so lower-ranked findings may be omitted from inline delivery.
